name: Mehmed V
role: Sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1909 to 1918
contribution: Mehmed V reigned as a constitutional monarch.
legacy: In his speech after the bay'ah prayer, he declared, "I am the first sultan of liberty and I am proud of it!" and from then on this person was known as the "Constitutional Sultan."

checks.lead: Mehmed V Reşâd (Ottoman Turkish: محمد خامس, romanized: Meḥmed-i ḫâmis; Turkish: V. Mehmed or Mehmed Reşad; 2 November 1844 – 3 July 1918) was the penultimate sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1909 to 1918. Mehmed V reigned as a constitutional monarch. He had little influence over government affairs and his ministries showed little regard for the constitution. The first half of his reign was marked by increasingly polarizing politics, and the second half by war and domination of the Committee of Union and Progress (CUP) and the Three Pashas.
